# Test fixtures

Every file here is synthetic: written for Zen IDE's tests from the public description of each
format (colour schemes, UI themes, keymaps, `.idea/` project settings), with invented names and
values. No file and no part of one is taken from a JetBrains product, a real scheme, theme, keymap
or project. Names a format requires, such as a parent scheme or an action id, are the format's
vocabulary that an importer has to read (ADR-0002).
